thread:
Maya: Heads-up — we plan to kick off a segmented pricing wave next Wed 05/11. Need sign-off on sheet + billing toggles.
Sam: Clarify targeting: cohort by signup date or product usage band?
Maya: By usage band. Wave 1 = 10k active PLG users split 85/15 control/variant. Variant = new per-token tier + minor embedding price bump.
Ritesh: I'll assemble the user list. Do we include trial accounts?
Maya: Exclude trials. Include only accounts with >= 7 days active usage in the last 30d.
Alan: Billing notes: for any users moving to variant we need to create an invoice delta flow so accounting can track credited vs billed amounts. Also confirm whether we apply a pro-rated credit for the current billing period.
Devon: Product recommends a 90-day grandfather window for customers on legacy tiers who are still active. No grandfathering for churned accounts.
Maya: Correct on the 90-day window. Also want a dry-run of invoice generation for a 500-account sample before rollout.
Ritesh: Reconciliation plan: run pre/post usage diff and revenue delta, threshold: <= 2% discrepancy. I'll run the SQL extract and share results.
Ritesh: SQL snippet I'll use: ```
SELECT customer_id, sum(billed_tokens) as tokens, sum(amount_usd) as amount
FROM usage_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2027-04-01' AND '2027-04-30'
AND account_status = 'active'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Sam: On infra — need a feature flag + rollout tag in config. Also we should add a metric for "pricing.variant" to ensure we can slice latency/cost.
Alan: Stripe question: we can set per-customer price overrides, but for accounting we should add an invoice line item labeled `pricing-experiment-adjustment` so reports can filter it.
Maya: Good. Who can own the migration script to push price overrides and the dry-run invoices? @Alan?
Alan: I can own the migration script. Plan: create subscription metadata, apply invoice items for the delta, run dry-run mode to email a report only (no live charges).
Devon: Product will prepare the rollout comms and a short FAQ for CS.
Sam: Ops: please add a canary of 200 users first, then scale to 2k, then full wave. Use gradual ramp with health checks.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created: `pricing-wave/2027-05-11` (canary=200 -> 2000 -> 10k) — see ops dashboard.
Maya: Timeline checklist: sheet final by EOD Tue, recon dry-run Wed morning, canary Wed afternoon, ramp Thur. If reconciliation exceeds 2% or invoices look wrong we will pause.
Ritesh: I'll post the pre-roll reconciliation CSV to #finance-reports when ready.
Maya: Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: when you have ownership items.
Alan: :thumbsup:
